title: Valiant Heart (1924)
problem: +1 attack and +1 cast for each ally whose secondary fusion equals the creature's own. Unfused creatures all store "none" (−1) and nothing excludes that, so they all match. The ally list includes the creature itself, so every creature on the side gets at least +1.
notes: Community claim: Unfused creatures count as having the same secondary Fusion. Evidence: bc_CreatureAttack L810-L819: allies incl. self @0x1406c6b89, fuse2 == fuse2 @0x1406c6cbd, +1 hit @0x1406c6ce6; bc_CreatureCast L781-L789 @0x140746a16 / 0x140746b5c. Fix sketch: H: skip allies with no secondary fusion (−1), and decide whether self counts. Triage 2026-10-26: Unfused creatures all match and the creature counts itself. Hook: skip allies without a secondary fusion (-1) and self. 2026-10-26 hook batch E built (research/hooks_E.json, loader/hooks_E.c). In-game test: Unfused creatures with Valiant Heart: no extra attacks/casts. A creature whose secondary Fusion matches 2 allies: +2 (it no longer counts itself).

release_notes.intended: Your creatures attack and cast 1 additional time for each creature with the same secondary Fusion.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, creatures counted themselves, and creatures without a Fusion all matched each other.
release_notes.fix: Now only other creatures with the same secondary Fusion count.
